evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I will be able to build you an accurate quote you can depend on, sounds good.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: May I please have the complete address where you're moving from... Three bedrooms and what is the square footage of your apartment? 1308... where you're moving to... Is this also an apartment or a house condo?
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised 'getting the best quote' and cost concerns ('I just wanted to get all the big stuff out of here... I'm gonna try to stay within that two and a half hour mark'). Nicole acknowledged but did not probe deeper with follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical three bedrooms apartment it usually takes around five to seven hours... In your case... I estimate this move to take around seven to eight hours... for seven to eight hours estimate. It's good to budget around $1,358 to $1,552.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: We charge $194 per hour for two movers and one truck... Everything is included in this hourly rate... There's no hidden fees of any type... Our minimum is two and a half hours once we go over the minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: No version of 'Does that feel fair?' was asked. Customer expressed confusion ('To be truly honest with you, no, it don't make sense to me') and Nicole pivoted to reframing the 2.5-hour minimum without asking for confirmation or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have no worries damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for any accidental damages... we're responsible for that, for the damages on your items and damages on your property.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move?
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (October 15th, 3:00 PM / 2-4 PM window), phone number (816-915-0483), arrival window (2:00 PM to 4:00 PM), email confirmed. Crew size (two movers, one truck) stated but not explicitly re-confirmed at booking. Addresses confirmed (5700 North D. Street, Halton City Apt 120 & 4808 Sparkling Pathway). No notes left for crew about customer's concerns (cost/time sensitivity, minimal move scope, storage contingency).

top_strength: Nicole gathered complete logistics details methodically (floor, bedrooms, square footage, appliances, destination type, parking access) and delivered full pricing transparency with fee breakdown and guarantees upfront.
coaching_note: When the customer expressed confusion about pricing, Nicole should have paused to ask 'Does that feel fair?' and held genuine silence for their response instead of immediately pivoting to reframe the minimum — that moment was the critical chance to confirm comfort before booking.
booking_note: Customer explicitly agreed to the move and a specific date/time was confirmed: 'I have secured a spot for you for Thursday, October 15th in the afternoon' with arrival window 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
